t: This is the Margaret MacDonald Memorial, a sculpture beside the path at the north edge of Lincoln's Inn Fields. It's by the sculptor Richard Reginald Goulden, and it has been grade two listed since 1974. It commemorates Margaret MacDonald, a feminist, social reformer and editor. She was married to the Labour politician Ramsay MacDonald from 1896, and she died in 1911 from blood poisoning.
